verdict.rationale: Deel ships an official MCP server that exposes platform operations as tools (e.g., listOfContracts, createTimeOffRequest, calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts). That lets users drive Deel in natural language through Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or other MCP clients, with OAuth handled automatically. However, natural-language operation depends on an external AI client, and there is no evidence of a first-party natural-language command interface inside Deel itself. Missing for 10: native in-product natural-language command interface, evidence of how broad the tool coverage is across all product operations, hands-on or independent corroboration of natural-language workflows.
